title: The calendar offers four views: Month, Week, Agenda and Plans

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: the suite's view control has seven segments (Day, Week, Month, Agenda, List, Kanban, Timeline); three of them (List, Kanban, Timeline) all show every Plan. On a phone seven segments do not fit one row. Fix: Month, Week, Agenda, Plans; Day opens by tapping a date; inside Plans, Board, List and Timeline are a sort, not separate views. DONE 2026-11-25: SUITE_VIEWS is the four tabs (Month, Week, Agenda, Plans). Day opens from a date in the Week view; inside Plans a second control sorts the same Plans as Board, List or Timeline, and the Plans tab reopens the layout used last. Old cookie words still resolve.

verify.note: Passes while the calendar header offers four tabs or fewer.
